## Properties

### keyboardLayout?

```ts
optional keyboardLayout?: boolean;
```

Defined in: [controllers/format-for-display.ts:26](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/lit-hotkeys/src/controllers/format-for-display.ts#L26)

Whether labels follow the user's keyboard layout, so `[KeyQ]` reads `A`
on a French AZERTY keyboard. The layout loads from the browser when the
first host connects. Only Chromium browsers report one. Set `false` to
never ask the browser for it. Default: `true`.

***

### platform?

```ts
optional platform?: HotkeyPlatform;
```

Defined in: [controllers/format-for-display.ts:19](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/lit-hotkeys/src/controllers/format-for-display.ts#L19)

The user's platform, for every label from `format`. Detected when unset.
On a server, set it from the request with `detectPlatform(userAgent)`.
